Report DescriptionTHE CALLER REPORTS A SPILL FROM THE COOLING TOWER BASIN DUE TO A MECHANICAL FAILURE. HE WAS NOTIFIED OF THE INCIDENT AROUND 7:00 A.M. THIS MORNING. THE WATER IS TAKEN FROM THE RIVER TO COOL THE PLANT"S SYSTEMS. THE CHEMICALS NORMALLY PRESENT ARE SODIUM HYPOCHLORITE AT A CONCENTRATION OF 0-1 PPM AND PHOSPHORUS AT A CONCENTRATION OF UP TO 11 PPM. VISUALLY, THE FLOW RATE WAS ESTABLISHED AT 500 LITERS PER MINUTE. THE SPILL IS NOT YET CONTAINED. THE CALLER WANTED TO ENSURE THE NOTIFICATION WAS CALLED IN AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE.

THE SPILL WAS CONTAINED WITH 700 GALLONS OF LIQUID ( WATER/DIESEL ) RECOVERED AND REMOVED. THE CONTRACTOR CHECKED THE STORM DRAIN SYSTEM BEYOND THE RELEASE AND NO EVIDENCE OF INCURSION INTO SURROUNDING WATERWAY WAS NOTED.
